hook: News (報) travelling its way (道) to you: media coverage, a report.
The head (頭) that pushes forward (冒) first: the very beginning of a speech or text.
Violent (暴) movement (動) of a crowd: a riot.
Praise (褒) given as something beautiful (美): a reward or prize.
Violent (暴) wind (風): a storm or gale.
葬 shows death (死) wrapped in grass (艹): to bury someone in the earth.
Let go (放) so it goes in (込む): to throw something into.
Let go (放) so it goes out (出す): to throw out, or give up on.
Full up (飽) and settled (和): saturation, it cannot hold any more.
Keep (保) warm (温): keeping the heat in.
Catch (捕) and get (獲) the animal: capture.
Make up (補) what was used by supplying (給) more: resupply.
Add (補) strength (強): reinforcement.
A teacher (師) who herds (牧) his flock: a pastor.
Catch (捕) whales (鯨): whaling.
The heart (忄) suddenly (忽) goes blank: to become senile or fuzzy.
Your mother (母) school (校), the school that raised you: alma mater.
Mother (母) country (国): your home country.
Words (言) made big (夸): to boast, to be proud of.
Threads (糸) that were fixed (定) come loose: seams split open, like lips into a smile.
Dried (干) things (物): washing hung out to dry.
Keep (保) and protect (守) things as they are: conservative, maintenance.
Make up (補) and fill (充) what is missing: replenish.
Dress (装) the road in a paved (舗) surface: pavement.
Add (補) what is not enough (足): a supplement.
Grave (墓) land (地): a cemetery.
Something starts (発) and makes (作) your body act up suddenly: a fit or attack.
Taken in (収) and gone (没) from you: confiscated.
Set off (発) on foot (足): a new group starts, an inauguration.
Sink (没) and fall (落): ruin, a fall from power.
施 as in 実施 (carry out): 施す means to give help or carry out a treatment.
Keep (保) and nourish (養) your health: rest and recuperation.
A caught (捕) captive (虜): a prisoner of war.
滅 has water (氵) over fire (火): the fire dies out, to perish.
Same 滅 (water putting out fire), but you do it: to destroy.
The real (本) standard (格): full-scale, the genuine thing.
Main (本) building (館).
Your origin (本) country (国): your own home country.
The main (本) body (体): the main unit itself.
Your original (本) ability (能), the one you are born with: instinct.
Buried (埋) and stored (蔵) underground: buried treasure or deposits.
舞 is dance, as in 歌舞伎 (kabuki): to dance, or flutter like leaves.
Exactly (真) above (上): right overhead.
Sell (売) before (前) the day: advance ticket sales.
Put (置) before (前) the main talk: a preface.
Entrust (任) it to someone, like 任せて (leave it to me): to leave it to them.
Make someone lose (負): to defeat them.
Money (貝, shell) so people have (有) what they need: to provide meals, cover costs.
Threads (糸) divided (分) and tangled: confusing, easy to mix up.
Tangled (紛) into a crowd: to slip in and get lost, or be distracted.
True (真) heart (心): sincerity.
Words (言) that become (成) real: truly, sincerely.
Win (勝) over others: to be better than, to surpass.
Cross (交) things together: to mix in, or cross swords.
Exactly (真) below (下): right underneath.
Cross (交) each other: lines intersect, people mingle.
Numb (麻) and drunk (酔) feeling: anesthesia.
Wait (待) and meet up (合): an arranged meeting at a place.
The wait (待) feels so far (遠): you cannot wait, looking forward to it.
Wait (待) and hope (望): to wait eagerly for.
The end (末) period (期): the final stage, near death.
Exactly (真) into two (二): split right in half.
纏 has thread (糸): things tied together into one, unity or consistency.
Thread (糸 in 纏) that ties everything up: a summary or conclusion.
免 as in 免除 (exemption): to be let off, to escape.
The eye (目) moves in an instant (瞬, as in 瞬間): a blink.
Numb (麻) and numb (痺) again: paralysis.
Made of leather (革): an old leather ball.
Whole and round (丸) just as it is: eat the apple entirely.
Round (丸) and round again (々): completely, fully.
Make it round (丸): to roll up into a ball.
A full (満) place (場): the whole audience, so unanimous.
Exactly (真) in front (前): right in front of you.
Exactly (真) round (丸): perfectly round.
Exactly (真) a circle (円): perfectly round.
Look (見) at each other to see if you match (合): an arranged marriage meeting.
Look (見) at each other (合わせる): exchange glances, then agree to wait, postpone.
Your look (見) drops (落) past it: to overlook.
Not yet (未) opened (開): undeveloped, uncivilized land.
Painful (苦) to look at (見): ugly, unsightly.
Not yet (未) married (婚): unmarried.
Not yet (未) ripe (熟): immature, unskilled.
Tiny (微) dust (塵): a speck, the smallest bit.
A feeling (気) of water (水): moisture.
Show (見せ) it off, waving it びらびら like a flag: to flaunt.
Water (氵) runs along it: a ditch or gutter, and also a gap between people.
Not yet (未) known (知): unknown.
A hand (寸) on the road (道): to guide or lead.
Gather (集) densely (密): a tight crowd.
Closely (密) connected (接): intimate, close.
Degree (度) of denseness (密): density.
Not yet (未) decided (定): undecided.
Seeing (見) all the way through (通): a clear view, the outlook.
See (見) it and make (なす) it so: to regard as.
A mountain (山) at its point: a peak or ridge.
What is on (上) your body (身): your life story, your situation.
Let it escape (逃) from your sight (見): to miss it.
Look (見) and measure (計): judge the right moment yourself.
Seeing (見) far in clear (晴) weather: a view.
Body (月, flesh) with branching streams: blood vessels, your pulse.
Not yet (未) done working (練) through it: lingering feelings, regret.
People's (民) lodging (宿): a family-run guesthouse.
People (民) of one family group (族): an ethnic group.
The man who joins the woman's (女) family: son-in-law.
No (無) effect (効): invalid.
No (無) words (言): silence.
No (無) wicked (邪) spirit (気): innocent like a child.
Tie (結) and attach (付): a connection.
Tie (結) and stick (付) together: to be connected.
Tie (結) something on (付ける): to join or attach.
Use (遣い) money for nothing (無駄): wasting money.
No (無) knowledge (知): ignorance.
No (無) tea (茶) for the guest? Absurd! (the kanji here are mainly for sound).
無茶 (absurd) plus 苦茶 (bitter tea) for rhythm: a total mess.
Empty (空) inside: vain, futile.
Your wish (念) comes to nothing (無): bitter regret.
No (無) ability (能): incompetent.
No (無) sense, like walking in darkness (闇): recklessly, at random.
A pattern (文) between two jewels (王王): spots, unevenness.
Like a flock of sheep (羊 in 群): to swarm, crowd together.
No (無) argument (論) needed: of course.
Famous (名) product (産): a local specialty.
The name (名) you call (称) it: an official name.
Hit (中) the life (命), right in the middle: a direct hit.
Bright (明) and white (白): clear and obvious.
Record book (簿) of names (名): a name list.
Bright (明) and clear to the eye (瞭): clarity.
Bright (明) and cheerful (朗): a sunny, open person.
目 was an old unit of weight, plus 方 (side, measure): the weight of something.
A gift from the heart (心 in 恵): a blessing.
Give from the heart (恵): to bless, to give charity.
So striking it wakes (覚) your eyes (目): remarkable.
Eyes (目) wake (覚): to wake up, like 目覚まし (alarm clock).
召 means summon: to call for, and politely to eat (召し上がる) or to wear.
めす sounds like Ms.: a female animal (male is おす).
How your eyes (目) are set (付): the look in your eyes.
Destroyed (滅) and gone (亡): the end of a nation.
A route (途) you can see (目): a goal, an outlook.
Marks (目) piled up (盛) in a row: the scale on a ruler.
Meet (会) face (面) to face: an interview or visit.
Exempt (免) and remove (除): let off from a duty or fee.
Turn your face (面) to it: to face onto.
Set up (設), as in 設計 (design): to create, to establish.
Humbly say (申し) and put it in (入れる): to propose.
Say (申) it and put it out (出): an offer or request.
Humbly say (申し) and come out (出る) with it: to offer or report.
Your part (分) to say (申し): an objection, as in 申し分ない (perfect).
A point (点) where the eye (目) is lost (亡): blind spot.
Fierce (猛) and burning (烈): violent, intense.
Record (録) of items (目): a catalogue.
Eyes (目) on it, discuss (論) and look (見): a plan, a scheme.
A copy (模) from a mold (型): a scale model.
Grope (模, used for 摸) and search (索): feeling your way to an answer.
Everyone holds (持ち) one topic all the way (切り): the talk of the town.
Right below (下) your eyes (目): at present, right now.
Exclusive (専), as in 専門 (speciality): solely, mainly.
Liking (好) odd things (物): idle curiosity, a curious person.
Things (物) are not enough (足りない): unsatisfying.
A model (模) example (範): a role model.
Copy (模) and imitate (倣): imitation.
Body part (月) you run away (退) with: the thigh. Same sound as もも (peach).
催 as in 開催 (holding an event): to hold a meeting or party.
Water (氵) and rain (雨) under the roof (尸): the roof leaks.
Same 漏 (rain getting under the roof): to leak out, slip out.
Body (月) in danger (危): fragile, easily broken.
Outside (外) in the fields (野): open air.
Night (夜) equipment (具): bedding.
Role (役) and job (職): an official or managerial post.
養 as in 栄養 (nutrition): to feed, raise, support.
A wild (野) heart (心): ambition.
Make it rest (休): to rest your body, give relief.
奴 once meant servant (woman 女 + hand 又): a rough word for a guy.
A superior (優) position (位): the advantage.
Worry (憂) and gloom (鬱): depression.
Has (有) benefit (益): useful, profitable.
Superior (優) and going beyond (越) others: superiority.
Brave (勇) and daring (敢): heroic.
Funds (資) that flow (融) to you: a loan.
Superior (優) force (勢): having the upper hand.
Invite (誘) and guide (導): leading someone along.
Melt (融) and pass through (通): flexible, adaptable.
Gentle (優) and beautiful (美): elegant.
Has (有) hope (望): promising.
Wander (遊) while herding (牧) animals: nomadic life.
Evening (夕) sky burning (焼): a red sunset.
Has (有) power (力): influential.
Invite (誘) and confuse (惑): temptation.
歪 is not (不) right (正): warped, crooked.
Shake (揺), as in 揺れる: to shake hard, to rock.
Water (氵), as in 洗濯 (laundry): to rinse.
Point (差す) a finger (指): to point at.
弓 looks like a bent bow: a bow for arrows.
Let the thread (糸 in 緩) go slack: to loosen.
Loose (緩) and easy: gentle, slow, lenient.
Dissolved (溶) liquid (液): a solution.
Nourish (養) and protect (護): nursing care.
The way (様) and form (式): a style or format.
Ask (請) for what you need (要): an official request.
How things look (様) and appear (相): the aspect or phase.
Use (用) method (法): how to use, directions.
